author: Digital Foundry
description:
It's the Digital Foundry Supporter Program that makes the DF Retro Super Show possible! Support the team, support the show, get high quality, ad-free video downloads of all DF content: https://patreon.com/digitalfoundry

John, Audi and Try are joined by Sean Cleaver from Blaze Entertainment to talk about the Evercade, a retro themed console that supports interchangeable cartridges and then they dive into the history of physical game media.

00:00 - Introduction
04:27 - News 1: M2 Emulation in MAME
10:05 - News 2: The Goemon Collection
19:29 - News 3: John Visits Audi
21:56 - Main Topic: The Evercade
40:42 - Looking back at the evolution of physical games
1:17:55 - Back to Evercade
title: DF Retro Super Show #018: The Rise of Evercade and the History of Physical Games
